_doc: Derived by tools/derive-ai-data.py from the cloudy-u-linux SOT da_my-ai/data/claude (names and counts only, no secrets). Never edit by hand.

rows.title: c3-infra
rows.caption: Owner rules (skill + rules/*.md), lean agents and PreToolUse guard hooks for the c3 fleet

rows.title: c3-infra
rows.caption: Owner rules for ANY fleet, Android app, CI, GitHub Actions, backlog/ticket, MCP, Caddy/addressing, secrets or agent-orchestration work in the c3 repos (cloud-*, _git-repos-master). Load before acting.

rows.title: build
rows.caption: Implementation worker for a single scoped change — edit files, run the build, report the diff. Use when the change is well-defined and self-contained.

rows.title: explore
rows.caption: Fast read-only scout. Use to find files, symbols, configs, or answer "where is X / which files do Y" across any repo. Returns locations + minimal excerpts, never edits.

rows.title: general-purpose
rows.caption: General-purpose agent for multi-step research and tasks. Lean override of the built-in: shell, file and web tools only, no MCP servers.

rows.title: infra
rows.caption: Worker for tasks that need the fleet tools (cloudy-c3-mcp incl. the phones, mail MCPs). Heavy at start (~55k tokens); use build/general-purpose when the MCPs are not needed.

rows.title: ops
rows.caption: Infra/CI runner — check gh workflow runs, tail logs, inspect docker/systemd state, verify deploys. Use for pipeline and fleet status work.

rows.title: review
rows.caption: Adversarial verifier. Give it a claim, finding, or diff — it tries to REFUTE it with evidence and returns CONFIRMED or REFUTED with proof. Read-only.
